VIX futures term structure: carry, tail risk and the link to SOFR

How much does the VX curve pay for being short volatility, how do you survive the blow-ups, and does VIX stress lead the SOFR curve? Sample 2016-01-04 to 2026-10-19; parameters chosen on 2016-2021, judged on 2022 onward.

84%of days the VX curve is in contango (VX2 > VX1)
0.069vol pts/day average roll-down of VX1 toward spot in contango ($69 per contract per day)
0.48net Sharpe, always short the front, full sample, max drawdown -$68k per contract
-0.27out-of-sample Sharpe of the in-sample-optimised defended strategy (2022 onward)
